Create a Gantt chart

Source: R/gantt_chart.R
gantt_chart.Rd

Draws tasks as bars along a time axis, one row per task, from their start to their end. Tasks can be coloured by group, show how far along they are (progress), depend on other tasks (drawn as arrows) and be compared with today's date. A task that starts and ends on the same date is drawn as a milestone (a diamond).

Usage

gantt_chart(
  data,
  task,
  start,
  end,
  group = NULL,
  progress = NULL,
  depends_on = NULL,
  today = NULL,
  sort = c("none", "start", "group"),
  colors = NULL,
  bar_height = 0.6,
  date_format = NULL,
  label_font_size = 11,
  zoom = TRUE,
  legend = TRUE,
  legend_font_size = 11,
  hover = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  title_font_size = 16,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bg_col = "white",
  text_col = "#333333",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per task.

task

The name of the column with the task names.

start, end

The names of the columns with the start and end dates (Date, POSIXct, or text such as "2025-03-14").

group

Optional. The name of a column to colour the tasks by (a team, a phase, ...).

progress

Optional. The name of a numeric column with the share of each task that is done, between 0 and 1.

depends_on

Optional. The name of a column with, for each task, the name of the task(s) it depends on (several names separated by commas).

today

Optional. A date to mark with a vertical line, or TRUE for today's date.

sort

How to order the tasks: "none" (the order of the rows, the default), "start" (by start date) or "group" (by group, then by start date).

colors

Optional. Colours of the groups: one per group or a named vector matched to the groups.

bar_height

The height of the bars as a share of each row. Defaults to 0.6.

date_format

Optional. A d3 time format for the dates in the tooltip, such as "%d/%m/%Y". Defaults to "%b %-d, %Y" (with the time when the dates have one).

label_font_size

The font size of the task names. Defaults to 11.

zoom

Logical. Let the viewer zoom and pan in time. Defaults to TRUE.

legend

Logical. Show a legend of the groups. Defaults to TRUE.

legend_font_size

The font size of the legend. Defaults to 11.

hover

Logical. Show tooltips and highlight on hover. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Logical. Grow the bars when the chart is drawn. Defaults to TRUE.

title

Optional. The title of the chart.

title_font_size

The font size of the title. Defaults to 16.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

text_col

The colour of the text. Defaults to "#333333".

width, height

Optional. The size of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

Hover a task to see its dates, duration and progress, and to highlight the tasks it depends on and the ones that depend on it. Scroll to zoom in time and drag to pan (zoom); double-click to reset. The bars grow from their start when the chart is drawn. Inside Shiny, clicking a task sets input$<id>_clicked to a list with task, start, end and group.

Examples

plan <- data.frame(
  task = c("Kick-off", "Research", "Design", "Prototype", "User tests",
           "Build", "QA", "Launch"),
  start = as.Date(c("2025-01-06", "2025-01-07", "2025-01-27", "2025-02-17",
                    "2025-03-10", "2025-03-03", "2025-04-14", "2025-05-05")),
  end = as.Date(c("2025-01-06", "2025-01-31", "2025-02-21", "2025-03-07",
                  "2025-03-21", "2025-04-18", "2025-05-02", "2025-05-05")),
  team = c("All", "Design", "Design", "Engineering", "Design",
           "Engineering", "Engineering", "All"),
  done = c(1, 1, 1, 0.8, 0.4, 0.3, 0, 0),
  after = c(NA, "Kick-off", "Research", "Design", "Prototype", "Design",
            "Build", "QA, User tests")
)
gantt_chart(plan, task = "task", start = "start", end = "end", group = "team",
            progress = "done", depends_on = "after",
            today = as.Date("2025-03-14"), title = "Product launch")



# The reigns of the last six British monarchs
reigns <- data.frame(
  monarch = c("Victoria", "Edward VII", "George V", "Edward VIII",
              "George VI", "Elizabeth II"),
  from = as.Date(c("1837-06-20", "1901-01-22", "1910-05-06", "1936-01-20",
                   "1936-12-11", "1952-02-06")),
  to = as.Date(c("1901-01-22", "1910-05-06", "1936-01-20", "1936-12-11",
                 "1952-02-06", "2022-09-08"))
)
gantt_chart(reigns, task = "monarch", start = "from", end = "to",
            colors = "#a463f2", date_format = "%Y")
